native_ETH_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
native_ETH_rule.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.

native_BTC_rule.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H.
